title: verdict-probes-report-to-the-watch
intention: Every standing WATCHME probe berthed in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict reports to harbor_master's watch verb with {ticket, holds, finding} stated against its own ticket's falsifier, and each spec names that receiver.
why: Every standing probe in cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict mails with no verb and nothing uses it (835b5736bf2b D2); a88d6a368cfb built the watch verb that uses a WATCHME finding and 8ecb99998254 built watch_carry. Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a: build the receivers.
traces_to: 835b5736bf2b's falsifier (zero probe-bearing standing specs lack a receiver) and Akien's answer to open-291189a9766a; the 2026-09-30 ruling that a probe's data must have a consumer that USES it; RULE 1 (the build stays inside cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict; base's helper through its public interface, harbor_master through its bus verb)
how: Measured 2026-10-03: 2 tickets at a rest carry a watchme probe under cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/probes/ (8e5db5f3edb2, ebf5392c8f93). Read 2026-10-03: two standing tickets carry a probe under cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/probes, neither declaring a verb. the_instrument_is_re_run_not_reported (8e5db5f3edb2) posts to='codemother' and is fails-shaped: TRUE when the stamped instruments are judgeable and the fraction that can bite is under the floor. discriminating_observation_probe (ebf5392c8f93) posts to='harbor_master' and is speak-shaped: TRUE on any verdict carrying the discriminating-observation field; its own carry names the fault as the early stop (4+ observations and under half naming a second tree), so holds is the negation of that. Proofs naming them: test_the_instrument_is_run asserts the probe has carry and enough (never to or verb). Each PROBE gets verb='watch' and carry=watch_carry(<its id>, _carry, <its predicate>), importing watch_carry from cairn.tools.base.probe (declared public). 1 post to='codemother' (8e5db5f3edb2) and retarget to='harbor_master'. Each ticket's watchme spec gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} through the artifact door. A proof under cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs reads the population from the commons and asserts each probe's verb, to, and live payload invariants.
falsifier: GREEN when every ticket at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme.probe sits under cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict has a probe whose PROBE posts verb 'watch' to 'harbor_master' and whose payload over live data carries ticket == that ticket's id, holds a bool, and a non-empty finding whenever holds is False; and every such spec names receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} with watchme_spec_error naming no receiver fault. RED if any standing verdict spec lacks the receiver, or if a converted payload's ticket is a path or another id, or if a probe still posts to codemother. WRONG INTENT if a verdict probe's data has a reader other than its own ticket's FIXME that only Akien could name.
watchme: none, because what this child's probes say is read by harbor_master's watch verb (a88d6a368cfb, PROVED), and whether they ever fire is 164da559823d's and acb4ecd84364's watch (CairnCommons/tickets/164da559823d-*.json); a probe on probes reporting would need a receiver of its own.
children: none, because the change is 2 PROBE declarations and their specs, all inside cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict.
builder_notes: A Haiku builder would ask: (1) Which probes and how: 8e5db5f3edb2 the_instrument_is_re_run_not_reported (fails=_trigger), ebf5392c8f93 discriminating_observation_probe (holds=_holds). In each file under cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/probes/: append watch_carry to the existing 'from cairn.tools.base.probe import ...' line; use the probe's id constant (named per probe below, added as `_TICKET_ID = "<id>"` after the import block when absent); in PROBE = Probe(...) replace 'carry=_carry,' with 'verb="watch",' and 'carry=watch_carry(<const>, _carry, <pred>),'. For the_instrument_is_re_run_not_reported also change to="codemother" to to="harbor_master". the_instrument_is_re_run_not_reported already holds its bare id in _OWNING_TICKET ('8e5db5f3edb2'), and its to='codemother' becomes to='harbor_master' (the watch verb is harbor_master's). discriminating_observation_probe holds _OWNING_TICKET as a slug; that stays and _TICKET_ID carries ebf5392c8f93. Its trigger is speak-shaped (TRUE on any verdict carrying the field), so it gains this holds predicate, inserted exactly as follows just above PROBE = Probe(: def _holds(context: dict) -> bool: ⏎     """The trigger speaks on any new verdict carrying the field; the fault is the early stop — ⏎     four or more observations and fewer than half naming a second tree (835b5736bf2b child).""" ⏎     s = once(context, "survey", survey) ⏎     return not (s["total"] >= 4 and s["fraction_naming_tree"] < 0.5) ; and passes carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, holds=_holds). Nothing else in a probe changes. (2) watch_carry exists in cairn/tools/base/probe.py (8ecb99998254); do not edit it. (3) Specs: each ticket's watchme spec whose probe starts with cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/probes/ gains receiver {what: 'harbor_master watch verb', in: 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'}, through cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write. (4) Proof: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_verdict_probes_report_to_the_watch.py, PROVES {'cb7c2c00940d': {'all': 'test_verdict_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}, modeled on cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py. (5) Every proof that imports a converted probe stays green: run them.

decisions.text: D1: the probes — In each of these files under cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/probes/: the_instrument_is_re_run_not_reported.py (8e5db5f3edb2: constant _OWNING_TICKET — already present; fails=_trigger), discriminating_observation_probe.py (ebf5392c8f93: constant _TICKET_ID — add it; holds=_holds) — append watch_carry to the existing `from cairn.tools.base.probe import ...` line; where the constant is to be added, add `<constant> = "<its id>"` after the import block; in `PROBE = Probe(...)` replace `carry=_carry,` with `verb="watch",` and `carry=watch_carry(<constant>, _carry, <its predicate>),`. In the_instrument_is_re_run_not_reported also change to="codemother" to to="harbor_master". the_instrument_is_re_run_not_reported already holds its bare id in _OWNING_TICKET ('8e5db5f3edb2'), and its to='codemother' becomes to='harbor_master' (the watch verb is harbor_master's). discriminating_observation_probe holds _OWNING_TICKET as a slug; that stays and _TICKET_ID carries ebf5392c8f93. Its trigger is speak-shaped (TRUE on any verdict carrying the field), so it gains this holds predicate, inserted exactly as follows just above PROBE = Probe(: def _holds(context: dict) -> bool: ⏎     """The trigger speaks on any new verdict carrying the field; the fault is the early stop — ⏎     four or more observations and fewer than half naming a second tree (835b5736bf2b child).""" ⏎     s = once(context, "survey", survey) ⏎     return not (s["total"] >= 4 and s["fraction_naming_tree"] < 0.5) ; and passes carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, holds=_holds). Nothing else changes; watch_carry is not edited.

D3: the proof — Create cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_verdict_probes_report_to_the_watch.py: a copy of cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py with the docstring naming cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict and ticket cb7c2c00940d; PROVES = {'cb7c2c00940d': {'all': 'test_verdict_probes_report_to_the_watch'}}; BERTH = 'cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/probes/'; _REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[6] (the repo root: the directory holding cairn/); teeth renamed test_every_standing_verdict_probe_posts_watch, test_every_standing_verdict_spec_names_the_receiver and the composite test_verdict_probes_report_to_the_watch. Structure, in full: imports importlib, json, subprocess, sys, Path; _REPO_ROOT on sys.path; parse_workflow from cairn.tools.base.transitions; watchme_spec_error from cairn.tools.base.watchme_spec; _main_tree() = Path(git -C _REPO_ROOT rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir).parent falling back to _REPO_ROOT; _tickets() = _main_tree().parent/'CairnCommons'/'tickets'; _standing() = (id, doc, spec) for each ticket at PROVED or WATCHME whose watchme spec's probe starts with BERTH, asserting non-empty; the posts tooth imports each probe module and asserts PROBE.verb == 'watch', PROBE.to == 'harbor_master', payload({}) carries ticket == the id, holds a bool, non-empty finding when holds is False (invariants only); the receiver tooth asserts spec['receiver'] == {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', 'in': 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'} and watchme_spec_error(doc) names no receiver fault; a __main__ block runs each, prints PASS/FAIL, exits 1 on any failure. No classes.

D4: the specs' receiver — Ticket files are /home/akien/dev/src/CairnCommons/tickets/<id>-<slug>.json (glob '<id>-*.json', exactly one). For each of 8e5db5f3edb2, ebf5392c8f93: doc = json.loads(Path(p).read_text()); the watchme is a dict or list of dicts; the spec whose 'probe' starts with 'cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/probes/' gets spec['receiver'] = {'what': 'harbor_master watch verb', 'in': 'cairn/devices/cairn/machines/harbor_master'}; then cairn.tools.artifact.artifact.write(p, json.dumps(doc, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n', verb='cast', why='<id>: the watchme names its receiver, harbor_master\'s watch verb (cb7c2c00940d)') — write(path, text, *, verb, why), text the WHOLE modified ticket. Run it as a script file (a shell command naming a record path and writing is refused by the artifact gate).

D5: green, seal, commit — Run cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_verdict_probes_report_to_the_watch.py (exit 0) and the probe-importing proofs (test_the_instrument_is_run); each must be green. Seal with `bin/cairn test --seal --timeout 900 cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_verdict_probes_report_to_the_watch.py <the probe-importing proofs>` (it runs each and writes its validation beside it). Commit with message 'cb7c2c00940d: verdict probes report to the watch' (the commit runs the reseal ladder, so allow an hour); commit the commons.

watch_carry is defined in cairn/tools/base/probe.py as watch_carry(ticket_id: str, carry=None, *, fails=None, holds=None) — exactly one of fails=/holds= passed as a keyword. "<its predicate>" is the literal keyword argument named for each file in this decision: fails=_trigger passes that probe module's existing module-level _trigger function (the one already given to Probe(trigger=...)); holds=_holds passes the _holds function this decision says to add. Example: carry=watch_carry(_TICKET_ID, _carry, fails=_trigger).

The template cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py exists on disk (sealed green under ticket 8d3c36e1fe59); it has teeth test_every_standing_inference_probe_posts_watch, test_every_standing_inference_spec_names_the_receiver and the composite test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch, which are copied and renamed as stated.

A ticket is standing when parse_workflow(doc["workflow_and_state"]).here (cairn.tools.base.transitions) is "PROVED" or "WATCHME"; a ticket whose workflow_and_state does not parse is skipped (except Exception: continue), exactly as the template does.

A ticket's watchme is a dict or a list of dicts. EVERY spec whose probe starts with the berth path gets the receiver (one or several per ticket); the proof's _standing() yields one (id, doc, spec) tuple per such spec.

The probe-importing proofs, by full path from the repo root: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/proofs/test_the_instrument_is_run.py. Commit cairn first (git -C ~/dev/src/cairn commit), then the commons as a separate commit (git -C ~/dev/src/CairnCommons add -A && commit).

Read 2026-10-03: cairn/devices/codemother/machines/verdict/probes/discriminating_observation_probe.py already imports once (from cairn.tools.base.probe import Probe, owning_ticket, once) and defines survey() at module level (def survey() -> dict), so the inserted _holds calls both without any new import.

The proof is created by copying the existing file cairn/devices/inference_domain/proofs/test_inference_probes_report_to_the_watch.py byte for byte (cp), then making ONLY the modifications this ticket lists (docstring, PROVES, BERTH, _REPO_ROOT depth, the three tooth names, plus any tooth this ticket adds). No generator script exists or is used: any earlier mention of child.py names a scratch script of the caster, not something the builder runs. The posts tooth obtains each payload as PROBE.payload({}) — Probe.payload runs the carry over that context.
